topics.title: His First Flight: the young seagull's fear

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why the young seagull could not bring himself to fly although he was physically able to.
Describe how the seagull's parents and siblings reacted to his refusal to fly.

topics.title: His First Flight: hunger and the mother's plan

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how hunger drove the young seagull to overcome his fear.
Interpret the mother's use of the piece of fish to make the seagull leave the ledge.

topics.title: His First Flight: the first flight and landing on the sea

concepts.learning_objective: Describe the seagull's feelings and movements during his first flight.
Evaluate the ending of the story and the lesson it conveys about overcoming fear.

topics.title: The Black Aeroplane: the night flight and the risk

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the setting and details of the narrator's flight in the Dakota.
Analyse why the narrator chose to fly into the storm and judge that decision.

topics.title: The Black Aeroplane: lost in the storm and the mysterious helper

concepts.learning_objective: Describe what happened to the narrator and his instruments inside the storm clouds.
Interpret the mysterious ending and the role of the black aeroplane.

topics.title: Vocabulary: meanings of 'black' and 'fly', and glossary words

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the meaning of the word 'black' in different contexts.
Use phrases with 'fly' and words with a meaning close to 'fly' correctly.
Recall the meanings of difficult words glossed in the chapter.
